module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  areset,
    input  train_valid,
    input  train_taken,
    output reg [1:0] state
);

    // Saturating counter logic
    always @(posedge clk or posedge areset) begin
        if (areset) begin
            state <= 2'b01; // Reset to weakly not-taken (2'b01)
        end else begin
            if (train_valid) begin
                if (train_taken) begin
                    if (state < 2'b11) begin
                        state <= state + 1;
                    end
                end else begin
                    if (state > 2'b00) begin
                        state <= state - 1;
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

endmodule
